Subject: Draft offer for Daniel Park — comp band request + start date

Hi Laura / Tessa,

Attaching the initial offer packet for Daniel Park (Senior ML Engineer) — see offer_RI_v1.pdf and a tracked redline (offer_RI_redlines.docx). Daniel interviewed with you and the infra team last week; he gave verbal interest and asked for an early April start if we can expedite.

A few open items I want your guidance on before I send to candidate:
- Compensation band: his target is $230k base + equity ask; current IC4 band tops at $210k base. We have flexibility up to $220k with manager approval; anything above requires headcount comp approval/level bump.
- Start date: candidate prefers 2026-04-06; we have onboarding available that week but final sign-off required from you.
- Signing bonus vs. base: he asked about a sign-on to bridge the base gap. If we offer $215k base + $20k sign-on (paid over 6 months) + 0.35% equity, that stays within comp allowance for IC4.
- IP/assignment and garden leave clauses: legal flagged a garden-leave carveout suggestion — see redlines.

Please review the clauses highlighted in the redline and flag any approvals or changes. If you approve the compensation combo above, I'll coordinate Neha for final payroll setup and loop in Markus for contract language edits. If you'd like a different structure (higher base vs. sign-on), let me know.

Thanks — I want to send to Daniel by EOD so we can lock his start date.

Monica
Monica Patel | Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Draft offer for Daniel Park — comp band request + start date

Monica — thanks for the packet and the clear summary. I read the redlines. Quick notes:

- Compensation: I'm comfortable approving $220k base + $15k sign-on (paid half at 30 days, half at 90 days) + 0.35% RSU grant on the current IC4 band as a manager-level exception. That keeps base nearer the band top and gives him immediate cash. If he pushes for $230k base, escalate to People/Comp for final approval.
- Start date: 2026-04-06 is fine; confirm with Neha that orientation and laptop provisioning are available that week.
- Title/level: Keep as Senior ML Engineer (IC4) — we can fast-track performance review at 6 months for promotion consideration. Please include that as a non-binding note in the offer ("promotion review at 6 months" phrasing).
- Garden leave: I'm okay with legal's cautious approach but prefer not to add arbitrary carveouts that weaken enforceability. Markus — please propose language that protects Redwood's IP while keeping the clause standard for Bay Area hires.

If everyone agrees, Monica, you can send the revised offer tonight.

L

Subject: Re: Draft offer for Daniel Park — comp band request + start date

Thanks — read through the redline. A couple legal/contract suggestions (summarized):

1) Garden leave / restrictive periods: Keep the standard 3-month garden-leave option (at company discretion) but explicitly tie it to base salary continuation at 50% if the company imposes garden leave. This is more defensible than unpaid garden leave language.

2) IP assignment: Add a one-sentence carve-in clarifying that inventions conceived on personal time that are unrelated to company business are excluded. This reduces pushback from experienced hires.

3) Termination for convenience: For mutuality, include a 2-week notice expectation for the employee (non-binding) and confirm that severance only applies if termination is without cause and above the tenure thresholds listed.

4) Equity vesting acceleration: Do not promise full acceleration; consider a single-trigger (pro rata) for change-in-control limited to the unvested portion for the first 12 months.

5) Governing law: Candidate requested CA law; confirm we keep CA as governing law for hires in CA (standard).

If you want, I'll update the redline and return by noon. Also --- Monica, flag any items that should be elevated to People Ops (Neha) for comp committee review.

Markus
General Counsel, Redwood Inference
